USAR should remain in the underfollowed lane pending verification of Stillwater commercial output, customer orders, feedstock provenance, and Less Common Metals integration.

node: Compliant rare-earth magnets and qualified non-Chinese feedstock
summary: Layer 1B expands the US-listed universe around the policy-sensitive chokepoint where procurement rules, NDAA-style origin restrictions, and defense supply-chain illumination could shift scarcity from headline rare-earth mining to qualified non-Chinese oxide, alloy, magnet, and feedstock provenance. The reference lane is MP Materials because it has the clearest US mine-to-magnet policy exposure. The underfollowed lane prioritizes USA Rare Earth, Energy Fuels, and Chemours because the market may under-map magnet-line commissioning, monazite-to-oxide processing, and heavy-mineral-sands feedstock dependencies as compliance bottlenecks rather than generic specialty-materials exposure.
